snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY XVI - Available on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox PC today | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
The legacy of the crystals has shaped our history for long enough. 
Five nations fight to claim the Mothercrystals.
As the fragile illusion of balance crumbles, the fates of the Dominants—those who harness the power of the Eikons—start to fall into mad disarray.
